blocks.en: For the general case, we refer the reader to the literature (cf. \cite{DS}), but when $n=1$ the proof is easy to see graphically. In this case the hypotheses of the theorem state that we have a continuous function $f$ which maps an interval $[a,b]$ into itself. The graph of the function must lie in the box $[a,b]\times[a,b]$ in the $(x,y)$-plane. There are only three possibilities: $f(a)=a$, $f(b)=b$ or the graph of $f$ starts to the left of the line $x=y$ and ends on the right. Since the function is continuous the graph must cross the line $x=y$ somewhere. Any crossing gives us a fixed point.
blocks.zh: 一般情形请读者参阅文献 (见 \cite{DS}); 但当 $n=1$ 时, 证明容易从图形上看出. 此时定理的假设是, 连续函数 $f$ 将区间 $[a,b]$ 映入自身. 函数图像必位于 $(x,y)$ 平面内的方框 $[a,b]\times[a,b]$ 中. 只有三种可能: $f(a)=a$, $f(b)=b$, 或 $f$ 的图像从直线 $x=y$ 的左侧开始, 在其右侧结束. 由于函数连续, 图像必在某处穿过直线 $x=y$. 任一交点都给出一个不动点.

blocks.en:
In this section we will see that we can expand some of the ideas of the previous section to infinite-dimensional spaces. We will assume $X$ is a real, reflexive Banach space and we study mappings $T:X\to X^*$. For an element $g\in X^*$ we will use the standard inner product notation and write $(g,v)$ for $g(v)$. \emph{In the remaining sections of this chapter, we will, in order to make the text easier to follow, give proofs only in the case where $X$ and $X^*$ are separable.}

We begin by giving a string of definitions which generalize concepts from functions on finite-dimensional spaces to mappings on reflexive Banach spaces.
blocks.zh:
本节将看到, 可以把前一节的一些思想推广到无限维空间. 假设 $X$ 为实自反 Banach 空间, 研究映射 $T:X\to X^*$. 对元素 $g\in X^*$, 使用标准内积记号, 将 $g(v)$ 写成 $(g,v)$. \emph{在本章的其余各节中, 为使叙述更易理解, 只在 $X$ 和 $X^*$ 都可分的情形下给出证明.}

首先给出一系列定义, 将有限维空间上函数的概念推广到自反 Banach 空间上的映射.

blocks.en: Let $\mathcal{A}_\alpha$ satisfy hypotheses \ref{hyp:monotone-pde-measurability}--\ref{hyp:monotone-pde-growth}, and let $p$ and $q$ be as defined in hypotheses \ref{hyp:monotone-pde-coercivity} and \ref{hyp:monotone-pde-growth}, respectively. Then, for every $f\in W^{-1,q}(\Omega)$, there exists a weak solution $u\in W_0^{1,p}(\Omega)$ of the Dirichlet problem for the quasilinear PDE \eqref{eq:monotone-quasilinear-dirichlet-equation}.
blocks.zh: 设 $\mathcal{A}_\alpha$ 满足假设 \ref{hyp:monotone-pde-measurability}--\ref{hyp:monotone-pde-growth}, 并设 $p$ 和 $q$ 分别如假设 \ref{hyp:monotone-pde-coercivity} 和 \ref{hyp:monotone-pde-growth} 中所定义. 则对每个 $f\in W^{-1,q}(\Omega)$, 拟线性 PDE \eqref{eq:monotone-quasilinear-dirichlet-equation} 的 Dirichlet 问题存在弱解 $u\in W_0^{1,p}(\Omega)$.
blocks.label: thm:monotone-quasilinear-dirichlet-existence

source_locations.bbox_precision: visually selected parent block, top-left PDF points

blocks.en: We break the proof of this theorem into a series of lemmas, the first of which is the following.
blocks.zh: 将这一定理的证明分成一系列引理, 第一个如下.

source_locations.bbox_precision: visually selected parent block, top-left PDF points

blocks.label: lem:monotone-pde-induced-bounded-dual-mapping

source_locations.bbox_precision: visually selected parent block, top-left PDF points

blocks.en:
The linearity of the mapping $v\mapsto B(u,v)$ is obvious. If $u,v\in W_0^{1,p}(\Omega)$, then, using \ref{hyp:monotone-pde-growth} and Hölder\textquotesingle s inequality, we get the estimate:\[\begin{aligned}
|B(u,v)|&\leq\sum_{|\alpha|\leq1}\int_\Omega|\mathcal{A}_\alpha(\bm{x},\delta_1(u(\bm{x})))D^\alpha v(\bm{x})|\,\mathrm{d}\bm{x}\\
&\leq\sum_{|\alpha|\leq1}\int_\Omega[c_1|\delta_1(u(\bm{x}))|^{p-1}+g(\bm{x})]|D^\alpha v(\bm{x})|\,\mathrm{d}\bm{x}\\
&\leq\sum_{|\alpha|\leq1}c_1\left\{\int_\Omega|\delta_1(u(\bm{x}))|^{q(p-1)}\right\}^{1/q}\left\{\int_\Omega|D^\alpha v|^p\,\mathrm{d}\bm{x}\right\}^{1/p}\\
&\quad+\sum_{|\alpha|\leq1}\left\{\int_\Omega|g|^q\,\mathrm{d}\bm{x}\right\}^{1/q}\left\{\int_\Omega|D^\alpha v|^p\,\mathrm{d}\bm{x}\right\}^{1/p}\\
&\leq C(\|u\|_{1,p}^{p-1}+1)\|v\|_{1,p}.
\end{aligned}\]This shows that for each $u\in W_0^{1,p}(\Omega)$ the mapping $v\mapsto B(u,v)$ is bounded. This implies the existence of the mapping $T$.

Furthermore, the same estimate shows that $T$ is bounded since
\begin{equation}\label{eq:monotone-pde-induced-dual-norm-bound}
\|T(u)\|_{-1,q}=\sup_{\substack{v\in W_0^{1,p}(\Omega)\\\|v\|_{1,p}=1}}|(T(u),v)|\leq C(\|u\|_{1,p}^{p-1}+1).
\end{equation}
Thus, $T$ maps bounded sets in $W_0^{1,p}(\Omega)$ into bounded sets in $W^{-1,q}(\Omega)$. This completes the proof.
blocks.zh:
映射 $v\mapsto B(u,v)$ 的线性是显然的. 若 $u,v\in W_0^{1,p}(\Omega)$, 则利用 \ref{hyp:monotone-pde-growth} 和 Hölder 不等式, 得到估计:\[\begin{aligned}
|B(u,v)|&\leq\sum_{|\alpha|\leq1}\int_\Omega|\mathcal{A}_\alpha(\bm{x},\delta_1(u(\bm{x})))D^\alpha v(\bm{x})|\,\mathrm{d}\bm{x}\\
&\leq\sum_{|\alpha|\leq1}\int_\Omega[c_1|\delta_1(u(\bm{x}))|^{p-1}+g(\bm{x})]|D^\alpha v(\bm{x})|\,\mathrm{d}\bm{x}\\
&\leq\sum_{|\alpha|\leq1}c_1\left\{\int_\Omega|\delta_1(u(\bm{x}))|^{q(p-1)}\right\}^{1/q}\left\{\int_\Omega|D^\alpha v|^p\,\mathrm{d}\bm{x}\right\}^{1/p}\\
&\quad+\sum_{|\alpha|\leq1}\left\{\int_\Omega|g|^q\,\mathrm{d}\bm{x}\right\}^{1/q}\left\{\int_\Omega|D^\alpha v|^p\,\mathrm{d}\bm{x}\right\}^{1/p}\\
&\leq C(\|u\|_{1,p}^{p-1}+1)\|v\|_{1,p}.
\end{aligned}\]这表明对每个 $u\in W_0^{1,p}(\Omega)$, 映射 $v\mapsto B(u,v)$ 都有界. 这就蕴含映射 $T$ 的存在性.

此外, 同一估计还表明 $T$ 有界, 因为
\begin{equation}\label{eq:monotone-pde-induced-dual-norm-bound}
\|T(u)\|_{-1,q}=\sup_{\substack{v\in W_0^{1,p}(\Omega)\\\|v\|_{1,p}=1}}|(T(u),v)|\leq C(\|u\|_{1,p}^{p-1}+1).
\end{equation}
因此, $T$ 将 $W_0^{1,p}(\Omega)$ 中的有界集映到 $W^{-1,q}(\Omega)$ 中的有界集. 证明完成.

source_locations.bbox_precision: visually selected parent block, top-left PDF points

blocks.en: The operator $T$ defined in Lemma~\ref{lem:monotone-pde-induced-bounded-dual-mapping} is monotone and coercive.
blocks.zh: Lemma~\ref{lem:monotone-pde-induced-bounded-dual-mapping} 中定义的算子 $T$ 为单调且强制的.
blocks.label: lem:monotone-pde-induced-mapping-monotone-coercive

source_locations.bbox_precision: visually selected parent block, top-left PDF points

blocks.en:
To prove monotonicity we use hypothesis \ref{hyp:monotone-pde-monotonicity} to get\[\begin{aligned}
(T(u)-T(v),u-v)&=B(u,u-v)-B(v,u-v)\\
&=\sum_{|\alpha|\leq1}\int_\Omega[\mathcal{A}_\alpha(\bm{x},\delta_1(u))-\mathcal{A}_\alpha(\bm{x},\delta_1(v))][D^\alpha u-D^\alpha v]\,\mathrm{d}\bm{x}\\
&\geq0.
\end{aligned}\]To prove coercivity we use hypothesis \ref{hyp:monotone-pde-coercivity} to get\[\begin{aligned}
\dfrac{(T(u),u)}{\|u\|_{1,p}}&=\dfrac{B(u,u)}{\|u\|_{1,p}}\\
&=\|u\|_{1,p}^{-1}\sum_{|\alpha|\leq1}\int_\Omega\mathcal{A}_\alpha(\bm{x},\delta_1(u))D^\alpha u\,\mathrm{d}\bm{x}\\
&\geq\|u\|_{1,p}^{-1}\left[c_0\int_\Omega|\delta_1(u)|^p\,\mathrm{d}\bm{x}-\int_\Omega h(\bm{x})\,\mathrm{d}\bm{x}\right]\\
&\geq\|u\|_{1,p}^{-1}C[\|u\|_{1,p}^p-1].
\end{aligned}\]Since $p>1$ we have
\begin{equation}\label{eq:monotone-pde-induced-mapping-coercivity-limit}
\dfrac{(T(u),u)}{\|u\|_{1,p}}\to\infty\quad\text{as }\|u\|_{1,p}\to\infty.
\end{equation}
This completes the proof.
blocks.zh:
为证明单调性, 利用假设 \ref{hyp:monotone-pde-monotonicity}, 得到\[\begin{aligned}
(T(u)-T(v),u-v)&=B(u,u-v)-B(v,u-v)\\
&=\sum_{|\alpha|\leq1}\int_\Omega[\mathcal{A}_\alpha(\bm{x},\delta_1(u))-\mathcal{A}_\alpha(\bm{x},\delta_1(v))][D^\alpha u-D^\alpha v]\,\mathrm{d}\bm{x}\\
&\geq0.
\end{aligned}\]为证明强制性, 利用假设 \ref{hyp:monotone-pde-coercivity}, 得到\[\begin{aligned}
\dfrac{(T(u),u)}{\|u\|_{1,p}}&=\dfrac{B(u,u)}{\|u\|_{1,p}}\\
&=\|u\|_{1,p}^{-1}\sum_{|\alpha|\leq1}\int_\Omega\mathcal{A}_\alpha(\bm{x},\delta_1(u))D^\alpha u\,\mathrm{d}\bm{x}\\
&\geq\|u\|_{1,p}^{-1}\left[c_0\int_\Omega|\delta_1(u)|^p\,\mathrm{d}\bm{x}-\int_\Omega h(\bm{x})\,\mathrm{d}\bm{x}\right]\\
&\geq\|u\|_{1,p}^{-1}C[\|u\|_{1,p}^p-1].
\end{aligned}\]由于 $p>1$, 有
\begin{equation}\label{eq:monotone-pde-induced-mapping-coercivity-limit}
\dfrac{(T(u),u)}{\|u\|_{1,p}}\to\infty\quad\text{as }\|u\|_{1,p}\to\infty.
\end{equation}
证明完成.

blocks.en: Lemma~\ref{lem:monotone-pde-induced-mapping-continuity} follows as a corollary to this theorem. To see this we simply need to apply hypotheses \ref{hyp:monotone-pde-measurability}, \ref{hyp:monotone-pde-continuity} and \ref{hyp:monotone-pde-growth} to see that each $\mathcal{A}_\alpha$ can be used as a Nemytskii operator satisfying the appropriate growth conditions. The continuity of $T$ from $W^{1,p}(\Omega)$ to $W^{-1,q}(\Omega)$ follows from the continuity of $\delta_1(\bm{x})\mapsto\mathcal{A}_\alpha(\bm{x},\delta_1(\bm{x}))$ as a map from $L^p(\Omega)$ to $L^q(\Omega)$.
